meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Transparent pricing for engineering support and project engagements.

intro.label: Pricing
intro.heading: Transparent by design.
intro.sub: Three published rates, plus a custom model: hourly support and fixed-price projects for engagements from ad hoc to 12+ months. The longer you commit, the lower the published rate. No hidden fees. All prices are exclusive of VAT — EU reverse charge applies for cross-border B2B transactions.

categories.title: Rates
categories.model: Per hour · published tiers or custom engagement
categories.desc: Three published rates, set by how long you commit, plus a custom model for 12+ month engagements. Your agreed rate applies to support and fixed-price projects alike — across the agreed scope.
categories.callout: We start with a free assessment: a conversation to understand your needs and see whether we are a good fit for each other. Neither side is obliged to proceed. Detailed technical investigation starts from €800 (one day), with scope and price agreed before proceeding.

terms.label: Standard minimum
terms.value: Quarterly and Semi-annual require at least 40 reserved hours per month; this minimum is non-negotiable

terms.label: Custom capacity
terms.value: Typically around 120 hours per month; exact capacity and maximum are agreed in the contract

terms.label: Committed hours
terms.value: Cover support or projects, are billed whether used or not, and expire each month

terms.label: Included
terms.value: Agreed engineering work, coordination, documentation and testing within the stated scope and capacity

terms.label: Separate costs
terms.value: Licences, cloud or hosting, production infrastructure, travel, dedicated test environments and optional availability require separate written agreement

notes: Detailed technical investigation examines code, logs or architecture and starts from €800 (one day). We agree its scope, deliverables, time limit and price, and obtain your approval before chargeable work starts.
You receive written findings covering risks and dependencies, options, a recommendation and a scoped estimate. You keep these findings whether or not you commission further work.

For systems we already understand, we use existing knowledge and documentation to identify any gaps. We agree only the investigation needed to scope the work; familiarity does not replace necessary checks.
Reserved capacity is limited; commitments are accepted in order of signing.
On-call availability, if required, is quoted separately; coverage, activation and response terms require a separate agreement.
Custom engagements are for 12+ month projects that need a tailored scope, delivery plan, capacity and budget. They do not imply unlimited work or a rate below €70 per hour.
Response times, service levels, and expenses are defined in the Master Service Agreement; scheduling, scope, and deployment responsibilities in each Statement of Work.

categories.title: Engineering Support
categories.desc: Escalation support for industrial software systems — the level your own team or vendor calls when they are stuck: incident investigation, root cause analysis, hotfixes, workaround guidance, documentation, and technical exploration.

terms.label: Out-of-hours
terms.value: 1.5× your rate — evenings after 18:00 CET, weekends, public holidays

terms.label: Emergency work
terms.value: Subject to availability at the applicable rate; an emergency request does not guarantee immediate response or on-call coverage

terms.label: On-call availability
terms.value: Separate written agreement defines coverage, activation and response terms; it is not included in the hourly rate

categories.title: Project Engagement
categories.model: Fixed price = estimated hours × your rate
desc: Refactoring, new features, migrations, and integrations. Agreed technical investigation, where needed, informs the hour estimate; multiplied by your rate, it is the fixed price — written in the Statement of Work before work starts.

The project consumes its estimated hours, not the hours actually worked. The price changes only if the agreed scope changes. A project of at least 40 hours per month over three months or more earns the Quarterly rate; a six-month commitment may use the Semi-annual rate when agreed in writing.
categories.guarantee: If Imbra's estimate was too low, Imbra absorbs the difference.
notes: For a reserved-capacity engagement, a fixed-price Statement of Work may allocate part of the paid monthly reservation to the project. Those hours are not invoiced again; the Statement of Work identifies the project allocation and remaining support capacity.
Projects outside reserved capacity are quoted and invoiced separately. Additional work requires written approval and remains subject to availability.

items.title: Small company — one legacy system
items.desc: Quarterly term, renewed for a year. Two-day technical investigation of a mid-sized legacy test framework, then support at the 40-hour monthly minimum.

items.title: Large company — 100 installations
items.desc: Semi-annual term, renewed after the six-month minimum, at an agreed 80 hours a month. Four-week technical investigation of a complex system estate, then support covering the agreed installations under one agreement.

items.title: Project — small integration
items.desc: No commitment. One-day technical investigation, then an 80-hour integration bridging two systems.

items.title: Project — runtime migration
items.desc: Quarterly term. A 400-hour project over four months, run with the client's own team — three-day technical investigation, then migration off an unsupported runtime.

items.title: Mixed month — project and support
items.desc: Quarterly engagement with 40 reserved hours in one month. A 24-hour fixed-price project uses part of the paid reservation; the remaining 16 hours stay available for support. Eight additional hours are approved separately after the reservation is fully allocated.

items.title: Emergency — business hours
items.desc: No commitment. 8-hour engagement on an already-understood system, on a weekday, subject to availability.

items.title: Emergency — weekend
items.desc: No commitment. 8-hour engagement on an already-understood system, on a Saturday, subject to availability.

legalNote: Full terms, including service levels, are defined in the Master Service Agreement.

cta.heading: Not sure which model fits?
cta.sub: Start with a free assessment to discuss your needs and whether we are a good fit for each other. Sending a message does not commit you to paid work.
